arxiv-2108-03491.title: Last Iterate Convergence in Overparameterized GANs
arxiv-2108-03491.creator: Elbert Du
arxiv-2108-03491.description: Abstract In this work, we showed that the Implicit Update and Predictive Methods dynamics introduced in prior work satisfy last iterate convergence to a neighborhood around the optimum in overparameterized GANs, where the size of the neighborhood shrinks with the width of the neural network. This is in contrast to prior results, which only guaranteed average iterate convergence.

arxiv-2309-03926.title: Large-Scale Automatic Audiobook Creation
arxiv-2309-03926.creator: Brendan Walsh* 1 , Mark Hamilton* 1,2 , Greg Newby 3 , Xi Wang 1 , Serena Ruan 1 , Sheng Zhao 1 , Lei He 1 , Shaofei Zhang 1 , Eric Dettinger 1 , William T. Freeman 2,4 , Markus Weimer 1
arxiv-2309-03926.description: Abstract An audiobook can dramatically improve a work of literature’s accessibility and improve reader engagement. However, audiobooks can take hundreds of hours of human effort to create, edit, and publish. In this work, we present a system that can automatically generate high-quality audiobooks from online e-books.

arxiv-2405-12981.title: Reducing Transformer Key-Value Cache Size with Cross-Layer Attention
arxiv-2405-12981.creator: William Brandon, Mayank Mishra *, Aniruddha Nrusimha, Rameswar Panda, Jonathan Ragan-Kelley
arxiv-2405-12981.description: Abstract Key-value (KV) caching plays an essential role in accelerating decoding for transformer-based autoregressive large language models (LLMs). However, the amount of memory required to store the KV cache can become prohibitive at long sequence lengths and large batch sizes.

arxiv-2407-16118.title: Normal edge ideals of edge-weighted graphs
arxiv-2407-16118.creator: Thanh Vu, Guangjun Zhu
arxiv-2407-16118.description: Abstract . We classify all normal edge ideals of edge-weighted graphs. 2010 Mathematics Subject Classification 13B22, 13F65, 90C05 1. Introduction Let R=\mathrm{k}[x_{1},\ldots,x_{n}] be a standard graded polynomial ring over a field \mathrm{k} . In [ MVZ ] , Minh, Vu, and Zhu classified all integrally closed and normal edge ideals of weighted oriented graphs.

arxiv-2408-16799.title: Replica Analysis for Ensemble Techniques in Variable Selection
arxiv-2408-16799.creator: Takashi Takahashi
arxiv-2408-16799.description: A 2024 arXiv research paper by Takashi Takahashi. Variable selection is a problem of statistics that aims to find the subset of the N N -dimensional possible explanatory variables that are truly related to the generation process of the response variable. In high-dimensional setups, where the input dimension N N is comparable to the data size M M , it is difficult to use classic methods based on p p -values. Therefore, methods based on the ensemble learning are often used.

arxiv-2502-08504.title: MoDitector : Module-Directed Testing for Autonomous Driving Systems
arxiv-2502-08504.creator: Renzhi Wang, Mingfei Cheng, Xiaofei Xie, Yuan Zhou, Lei Ma
arxiv-2502-08504.description: Abstract . Testing Autonomous Driving Systems (ADS) is crucial for ensuring their safety, reliability, and performance. Despite numerous testing methods available that can generate diverse and challenging scenarios to uncover potential vulnerabilities, these methods often treat ADS as a black-box, primarily focusing on identifying system failures like collisions or near-misses without pinpointing the specific modules responsible for these failures.

arxiv-2508-06759.title: From Theory to Forecast: Neutrino Mass Effects on Mode-Coupling Kernels and Their Observational Implications
arxiv-2508-06759.creator: Farshad Kamalinejad, Zachary Slepian
arxiv-2508-06759.description: Abstract We present an analytical expression that gives both the matter and tracer (halo or galaxy) power spectrum with 1-loop corrections that include the neutrino effects on the mode coupling kernels. We use the FFTLog algorithm to accelerate calculating the higher-order corrections to the power spectrum. We then use our power spectrum and bispectrum models to pursue two main goals.

arxiv-2511-11263.title: Multiple correlation lengths and type-1.5 superconductivity in U ⁡ ( 1 ) U(1) superconductors due to hidden competition between irreducible representations of nonlocal pairing
arxiv-2511-11263.creator: Anton Talkachov, Paul Leask, Egor Babaev
arxiv-2511-11263.description: Abstract A fundamental characteristic of a superconducting state is the coherence length ξ \xi . Multicomponent superconductors, particularly ones breaking multiple symmetries, are characterized by multiple coherence lengths. Here we show that even, nominally single -component superconductors under certain conditions are characterized by multiple coherence lengths.

pmc-10675783.title: Current Status of Biotechnological Approaches to Enhance the Phytoremediation of Heavy Metals in India—A Review
pmc-10675783.creator: Selvaraj Barathi, Jintae Lee, Raja Venkatesan, Alexandre A Vetcher, Karthik Chinnannan, Padma Nimmakayala
pmc-10675783.description: Rising waste construction, agricultural actions, and manufacturing sewages all contribute to heavy metal accumulation in water resources. Humans consume heavy metals-contaminated substances to make sustenance, which equally ends up in the food circle. Cleaning of these vital properties, along with the prevention of new pollution, has long been required to evade negative strength consequences.

pmc-10719328.title: Observation of the validity of the upper lip bite test in predicting difficult intubation
pmc-10719328.creator: Xinyuan Tang, Zhiyuan Dong, Jianling Xu, Pingping Cheng, Mingfang Wang, Bin Wang, Xiaogan Jiang, Weidong Yao
pmc-10719328.description: The upper lip bite test (ULBT) is considered an effective method for predicting difficult airways, but data on the ULBT for predicting difficult tracheal intubation are lacking. This study aimed to examine the clinical utility of the ULBT in predicting difficult endotracheal intubation.

pmc-11314036.title: Enhanced Visible-Light Photocatalytic Activity of Bismuth Ferrite Hollow Spheres Synthesized via Evaporation-Induced Self-Assembly
pmc-11314036.creator: Thomas Cadenbach, Valeria Sanchez, Karla Vizuete, Alexis Debut, Carlos Reinoso, Maria J Benitez, Ruowen Liang
pmc-11314036.description: Semiconductor hollow spheres have garnered significant attention in recent years due to their unique structural properties and enhanced surface area, which are advantageous for various applications in catalysis, energy storage, and sensing. The present study explores the surfactant-assisted synthesis of bismuth ferrite (BiFeO3) hollow spheres, emphasizing their enhanced visible-light photocatalytic activity.

pmc-11331091.title: Structural basis for coupling of the WASH subunit FAM21 with the endosomal SNX27–Retromer complex
pmc-11331091.creator: Qian Guo, Kai-en Chen, Manuel Gimenez-Andres, Adam P. Jellett, Ya Gao, Boris Simonetti, Meihan Liu, Chris M. Danson, Kate J. Heesom, Peter J. Cullen, Brett M. Collins
pmc-11331091.description: SignificanceCell surface transmembrane proteins are regulated by a constant cycle of internalization and recycling from intracellular endosomal compartments. The Retromer protein complex and the sorting nexin (SNX) adaptor protein play a critical role in the retrieval of hundreds of proteins responsible for ion transport, glucose metabolism, neurotransmission, and other cell functions.

pmc-11486997.title: The potential of gene drives in malaria vector species to control malaria in African environments
pmc-11486997.creator: Penelope A. Hancock, Ace North, Adrian W. Leach, Peter Winskill, Azra C. Ghani, H. Charles J. Godfray, Austin Burt, John D. Mumford
pmc-11486997.description: Gene drives are a promising means of malaria control with the potential to cause sustained reductions in transmission. In real environments, however, their impacts will depend on local ecological and epidemiological factors. We develop a data-driven model to investigate the impacts of gene drives that causes vector population suppression.

pmc-12716253.title: Protecting Public Health: Stories of Adaptation from Communities Across the Globe
pmc-12716253.creator: Praveen Kumar, Stella Hartinger, Sokhna Thiam, Amit Mistry, Jenna R. Durham
pmc-12716253.description: es, erratic precipitation, extreme weather events, sea level rise, wildfires, and desertification [2]. The climate stressors have exacerbated exposure to conditions such as high heat stress, reduced air quality, disruptions to food and water systems, migration and internal displacement, resource conflicts, and changes in infectious agents [1].

pmc-13007093.title: SOCAV: a nurse-led support programme for self-direction in people with dementia receiving home care, involving informal caregivers – a feasibility study with process evaluation in the Netherlands
pmc-13007093.creator: Phébe Das, Gerbrich Douma, Hanneke Donkers, Lieve Roets-Merken, Maud Graff
pmc-13007093.description: AbstractObjectivesTo adapt the SOCAV programme—originally developed for residential dementia care—for home care use, and to evaluate its feasibility and potential to foster behavioural change in nurses and informal caregivers supporting self-direction in people with dementia.DesignDevelopment and feasibility study guided by the Medical Research Council framework for complex interventions. Feasibility was evaluated using Bowen’s framework (demand, acceptability, practicality, implementation, limited efficacy).

pmc-13190425.title: Comparison of Masimo O3 and INVOS 7100 cerebral oxygenation during immediate neonatal transition
pmc-13190425.creator: Prathomwalee Sintupech, Amonrat Anantho, Kamonrat Songnok, Ratchada Kitsommart
pmc-13190425.description: A peer-reviewed research article from Europe PMC (2026). This study aims to compare CrSO2 measured simultaneously by Masimo O3 and INVOS during the first 15 min after birth in healthy term infants and to evaluate agreement and derived cerebral fractional tissue oxygen extraction (cFTOE). In this prospective observational study, 65 healthy term infants were monitored immediately after birth using Masimo O3 and INVOS 7100 applied simultaneously with randomized hemispheric placement. Pre-ductal oxygen saturation (SpO2) was recorded continuously.

pmc-13666014.title: SPRIZ (CCDC127) protein conserved in deuterostome animals is a rigid OMM–IMM tether that locally sets mitochondrial IMS volume
pmc-13666014.creator: Raman Shulinski, Roman Loban, Danny Farhat, Benjamín Cartes-Saavedra, Matthew J. Magda, Pavel Kotchetkov, Victoria Caminiti, Linda David, Yuri I. Wolf, Conor O’Dwyer, Morgan Fullerton, Yan Burelle, Jyh-Yeuan (Eric) Lee, Andrea Raimondi, Eugene V. Koonin, György Hajnóczky, Mary-Ellen Harper, Luca Pel
pmc-13666014.description: The double-membrane nature of mitochondria generates an intermembrane volume through which ions, reactive oxygen species, and metabolites must flux to reach the matrix or cytosol, but whether this volume is a genetically specified structure remains unknown. We identify SPRIZ (spatial regulator of the intermembrane zone), the product of Ccdc127, a gene conserved across deuterostome animals.

uslaw-usc-t12-s204.title: 12 U.S.C. § 204 — Examinations
uslaw-usc-t12-s204.creator: United States Congress
uslaw-usc-t12-s204.description: United States Code, Title 12 (Banks And Banking); Chapter 2 (National Banks); Subchapter XIV (Bank Conservation Act). Current through Public Law 119-134, as published by the Office of the Law Revision Counsel. The Comptroller of the Currency (in consultation with the Board of Directors of the Federal Deposit Insurance Corporation when the Corporation is appointed conservator) is authorized to examine and supervise the bank in conservatorship as long as the bank continues.
